question: Which folk music is a mix of Indian and western music and is popular in Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mando**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mando** is a folk music form that is a mix of Indian and western music.
 
• It is particularly popular in **Goa**.
 
• The music style often includes instruments like guitars, violins, and traditional Indian instruments.
 
• Mando songs typically revolve around themes of love, historical events, and social issues.
 
• This genre originated during the Portuguese colonial era in Goa, blending local and European musical traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Mando** is often performed at weddings, festivals, and other cultural events in Goa.
 
• It is characterized by its melodic and harmonic richness.
 
• The **Goan Carnival** is one of the occasions where Mando is prominently featured.
 
• Efforts are being made to preserve and promote this unique musical tradition.
